claims: As of March 2026, the Miami Dolphins have signed quarterback Malik Willis to a three-year, $67.5 million contract.
The Miami Dolphins released Tua Tagovailoa.
Malik Willis is the Miami Dolphins' new starter.
Malik Willis served as a backup with the Green Bay Packers.
Malik Willis was a third-round pick by the Tennessee Titans in 2022.
Malik Willis is the presumed starting quarterback for the 2026 Dolphins season.
ESPN's depth chart lists rookie Quinn Ewers as the second-string QB for the Dolphins.
The Dolphins moved on from Tua Tagovailoa after multiple seasons
